messages:
Maya: noticing a big latency tail from na-west around 09:10 UTC, looks correlated with provisioner backfill jobs spiking and the new prefetch controller rollout
Noah: saw that too, p50 fine but p99 -> +350ms for token generation on a few models
Jin: oncall, investigating. Any recent runtime rollouts?
Maya: we rolled runtime v2.4.1 to na-west ~08:55 (prefetch controller enabled). Also increased hotpool min from 4->6 for stress tests
Noah: suspecting prefetch controller is over-aggressively evicting KV entries during backfill, causing lots of cold misses + batch amplification
Rachel: graph of kvcache_miss_rate shows a 6x jump starting 08:58 in na-west. Also egress NAT connections spike at same time
Ops-bot: INCIDENT created: #infra-2300456789 - na-west latency surge, kvcache miss storm
Maya: logs showing repeated eviction logs: `prefetch_controller evict shard=12 reason=backfill_pressure age=3s`
Noah: can we flip prefetch controller to conservative mode? There's a flag `--prefetch-mode=conservative` on provisioner service
Jin: on it. Patching config now, will roll 2 nodes at a time. command: `kubectl set env deployment/provisioner PREFETCH_MODE=conservative -n infra`
Noah: also let's temporarily increase hotpool headroom to avoid backfill. `kubectl patch cm infra-config -p '{"hotpool_min":8}'` then restart provisioner pods slowly
Maya: doing the config bump and a staged restart. ETA ~6 mins
Rachel: routing-wise we should start shifting a small % of traffic to eu-west to ease pressure. Can ops-platform run a gradual reroute?
Noah: I can create a policy: `trafficctl route add --from na-west --to eu-west --percent 15 --models=all --dry-run=false`
Maya: please hold on dry-run=false until after we confirm prefetch change. We don't want double-shift
Jin: prefetch conservative patched and rolling, 1/6 pods done, patch logs show `prefetch mode set to conservative`
Maya: seeing immediate drop in eviction logs on pod-3, kvcache miss rate down ~40% there
Rachel: good. start dry-run= true for routing to verify canary responses. Noah please start with 5%
Noah: started `trafficctl route add --from na-west --to eu-west --percent 5 --models=llama-2-* --dry-run=true`
Ops-bot: Alert: provisioner restart triggered health-check flaps on 2 pods, autoscaler suppressed due to reserved capacity policies
Maya: acknowledged, monitoring. Healthy pods are handling the load but latency still above baseline by ~120ms p99 overall
Jin: digging into egress NAT saturation — SNAT port exhaustion looks possible. If NAT is saturated we see connection queueing that increases RPC latency for KV fetches
Noah: opening cloud console NAT metrics, connections_per_nat ~ 62k (threshold ~65k) but ephemeral ports used spike on restart windows
Rachel: mitigation: enable additional NAT gateways in na-west-2 and shift some egress through them. Ops-platform can do that quickly?
Maya: ops-platform oncall is adding one more NAT gateway now. Also asking infra to increase ephemeral port range on the provisioner side to reduce churn
Noah: meanwhile, to reduce pressure we can enable local kv warmup for high-traffic models: `runtime-config set --model-regex='chat-*' kv_warmup=true --ttl=30m`
Maya: enabling kv warmup for top 8 models now. That should reduce cold miss storms during backfill
Jin: prefetch rollout finished, all provisioner pods now conservative mode. kvcache miss rate down 65% from peak
Rachel: NAT gateway added, connections redistributed. egress queue length normalized
Noah: starting to undo dry-run flag and ramp route to 15% now that conservative mode is stable: `trafficctl route update ... --percent 15 --dry-run=false`
Maya: confirmed p99 now ~+40ms vs baseline. Still elevated but within acceptable for failover period. Continuing to monitor for 30m
Rachel: creating follow-up ticket to add circuit breaker in prefetch controller to avoid future runaway eviction during backfill: INFRA-4021
Ops-bot: Note: deploy-bot reported no runtime version rollbacks. `deploy-bot`: no active deploys during incident
Noah: postmortem action items: revert hotpool min change if not required, add NAT autoscaling, add prefetch circuit breaker, add k/v warmup toggle per-pool
Maya: thanks team. I'll keep thread open for the 30m observation window. Ping if anything regresses :thumbsup:
